findings.blocker_rationale: The actual canonical state was exhaustively checked and does not use any of the accepted corruptions.
findings.description: The copied existing-manifest preflight accepted duplicate identifier metadata and a ../ path outside REPO_ROOT when the declared hash matched; a semantic verifier accepted a consistently rebound episode-block order; the final durable-file verifier accepted a byte-identical external symlink.
findings.impact: These are meaningful supply-chain/hardening weaknesses and could permit substitution or duplication before the confirmation input seal. They did not compromise the preserved result: canonical paths are confined and regular, IDs/paths/hashes are unique, row order is exact, and initial/final snapshots are unchanged.
findings.title: Artifact validators have pre-seal path and manifest fail-open surfaces

findings.blocker_rationale: No tested reasonable correction reverses the effect.
findings.description: The stated total is an exact integer under the frozen historical latent-prediction ledger, not a literal count of all executed operations. It excludes pixel encoding and visible bias/GELU/alpha/residual arithmetic; the base predictor also lacks a complete primitive graph.
findings.impact: The claim must be scoped to the declared convention. Comparator fairness survives: common omissions cancel, adding 704 or 832 visible operations per later adapter slightly increases the raw advantage, and every sensitivity keeps the seeded comparator weakly more compute.
findings.title: The unqualified exact-FLOP claim is not literal end-to-end arithmetic

findings.blocker_rationale: Exact full replay bounds the unresolved surface; no mismatch exists.
findings.description: The seal records interpreter hashes, exact package versions, and top-level module origins, but not all imported Python files, native libraries, the Metal/MPS framework or OS build, nor a loaded-module snapshot.
findings.impact: An exact historical environment cannot be reconstructed solely from the seal. Current dual-runtime probes and a bitwise-exact 60,800-row MPS replay make a decision-changing historical substitution unsupported, but cannot retroactively attest it.
findings.title: Historical transitive runtime environment is incompletely attested

findings.blocker_rationale: Post-training chronology and fresh seed derivation make exact V5 membership in the unavailable training corpus non-credible.
findings.description: The repository does not preserve an episode-level raw corpus for original base-model training, so observation-level absence/near-absence across that entire historical corpus cannot be tested.
findings.impact: All accessible evidence is clean—2,472 prior raw archives, 31,629 IDs, 28,427 seeds, transformed seeds, initial states, actions, observations and pixels—and V5 was generated later from fresh unique seeds. This leaves a bounded provenance uncertainty, not evidence of direct cohort leakage.
findings.title: Complete original base-model training raw corpus is unavailable

findings.blocker_rationale: This is a defect in this audit's mapping, not in V5 data or computation.
findings.description: The seal marked all 49 tests mandatory for both supported outcomes, while reserving invalidation for a validated Blocker and inconclusive for essential missing/corrupt evidence or persistent critical disagreement. Resolved, non-invalidating failures therefore create a gap in which none of the four sealed labels is available.
findings.impact: No failed test was relabeled. Because the user requires exactly one outcome, the governing top-level definitions are applied: no Blocker, exact primary reproduction, and bounded Major caveats map most truthfully to v5_validity_supported_with_caveats.
findings.title: The sealed audit plan has an internally over-strict terminal mapping

findings.description: The retained raw plus-one p-value is 0.164835. A second pair-matrix method agrees to 1.58e-19, so this is not a harness error.
findings.impact: Whole-target reassignment changes the physical prediction task and has 15.1× the null SD of matched allocation controls. All sharper reachability/histogram/score-gain controls pass; a separately labeled post-hoc loss-profile permutation also passes. The preregistered failure remains visible.
findings.title: Predeclared whole-episode target permutation fails in raw space

findings.description: The manifest omits device and command fields. MPS is strongly inferred from the launcher default, MPS qualification and exact full MPS replay.
findings.impact: Reproducibility/attestation gap; no observed numerical discrepancy.
findings.title: Historical execution device/command is not explicit in the execution manifest

findings.description: artifact_manifest.json freezes PACKAGE_READY before confirmation. The input seal and independent verifier bind decision inputs, but raw sidecars and all post-confirmation outputs are not collected in a second complete manifest.
findings.impact: The audit's initial/final full snapshots close the preserved-evidence gap.
findings.title: No post-decision complete package path-set manifest exists

findings.description: Unknown privileged canaries can be present before manifesting, but only action and pixels are subscripted/materialized and outputs remain exact.
findings.impact: No target leak; strict unknown-field rejection would improve defense in depth.
findings.title: Raw loader safely ignores rather than schema-rejects unknown fields

findings.description: Timestamps are not externally notarized and raw files are hashed before open; a change-and-restore inside that window is not cryptographically excluded.
findings.impact: Strict ordering, pre/post hashes, exact replay and unchanged final snapshots provide strong but not notarized custody.
findings.title: Chronology relies on mutable local timestamps and has a narrow TOCTOU window

findings.description: The first harness applied an absolute-only 2e-6 cap to an algebraically different sqrt/sum reduction and omitted the preregistered relative term.
findings.impact: Synthetic validation identified the audit-harness defect. No tolerance was relaxed: order-matched features/scores are exact; explicit algebra passes audit tolerance; every call/output is exact. Only 88/1,600 episodes satisfy the package's stricter score allclose under that deliberately different order.
findings.title: Initial replay audit acceptance logic produced a false failure

precise_supported_claim: For the frozen v004 PlanOracle confirmation cohort, the sealed causal adaptive policy produced lower episode-averaged raw and native-whitened latent MSE than the strongest transition-independent comparator at the same declared latent-prediction operation budget, with the preregistered intervals and outcome mapping independently reproduced.

terminal_reasoning.governing_user_definition_applied: no Blocker plus exact confirmation reproduction plus bounded Major uncertainty => v5_validity_supported_with_caveats

unsupported_claims: broad generalization beyond the frozen PlanOracle DGP
literal end-to-end exact arithmetic FLOPs including pixel encoding
fail-closed resistance to every pre-seal manifest/path substitution
